summary: Iteration 201: Tested address discovery endpoint and WalletAddressBook UI. Backend endpoint /api/wallet/discover-addresses/{address} works correctly with proper response shape. Frontend WalletAddressBook component renders with 'Scan Chain' button (data-testid='discover-addresses-btn'), filter tabs, and address list. IPFS upload has no size cap. Nginx has client_max_body_size 0.

minor.issue: External mempool.space API can be slow (15-60s) causing timeouts in test environment, but endpoint handles gracefully

VERIFIED: Addresses are categorized as 'dust' (546 sats) or 'payment' based on first_value
VERIFIED: Endpoint handles pagination of transaction history (up to 500 txs via 20 pages of 25)
VERIFIED: Frontend WalletAddressBook component compiles without errors
VERIFIED: 'Scan Chain' button present with data-testid='discover-addresses-btn'
VERIFIED: Filter tabs include 'All', 'Main', 'Change' - 'Dust (546)' and 'Payments' tabs appear when discovered addresses exist
VERIFIED: Discovered addresses persist in localStorage under cthulhu_discovered_{address} key
VERIFIED: IPFS upload endpoint at /api/ipfs/upload has no file size cap (line 251 in ipfs.py)
VERIFIED: useAuth.js importWallet and importKeyLogin trigger background discovery via fetch to /api/wallet/discover-addresses
